name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No Atlantic tropical cyclone listed on 19 Nov; the season ends on 30 Nov
state: GDACS listed two tropical cyclones worldwide at 05:40 UTC on 19 Nov, Akvan near India and Xavier near the Cook Islands, and none in the Atlantic basin (GDACS). El Niño wind shear has kept the 2026 Atlantic season quiet, with one hurricane by early November (Nature World News). The season formally ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No Atlantic storm threatens land. Check the National Hurricane Center before travel to the Caribbean.
rubric_hit: No hurricane active or threatening land = Normal

sources.title: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System
Nature World News — Atlantic has produced just one hurricane in 2026

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
